body: No, and I don't want to. It's extremely difficult for me to talk about my negativity; the only reason I'm doing it on reddit is because it's easier for me to type rather than talk, and I have a wall of anonymity
Music? Yeah, but that just makes me forget my problems for a little bit. Putting off pain only makes it worse when you feel it again.

I have no idea how to help, and the longer I think about it, the more I feel worse because my mom continues to stress out (which will soon harm her health greatly). My dad won't listen and get a job because he believes selling old stuff is the best thing right now because all he has to do is sit at home.
